note: Alger County's only public parcel viewer is Colligo GIS (colligogis.com/desktop), which is a login page with no public service URL. The county equalization page offers only a GIS Data Request form. Parcel data is otherwise sold by commercial vendors (Regrid, Dynamo Spatial, Land Records, Rockford Map). ArcGIS search for Alger parcels returned no hosted FeatureServer or MapServer. The state MGF says its statewide parcel layer is internal-only.
